_comment: The owner's default rules (owner decision 10, 23 November 2026; docs/specs/rules-engine.md section 4, ADR-0060): one rule
per bullet of the owner's list, the bullet's words kept. Every default is editable and removable in Settings. The host
writes them into <root>/boopis/rules.json (crates/boopis-rules); the plugin reads this copy (plugins/boopis/data/, synced
by scripts/sync-shared-data.sh) for a root whose rules.json does not exist yet. `kinds` are what a rule can concern: the
reviewer judges a rule only for a call that has one of them. `defaults_version` goes up when a text changes or a rule is
added; a removed default stays removed (`removed_defaults`).

rules.text: Ask before deleting or overwriting files outside the bot's workspace, or running rm -rf on broad paths.
Ask before running as root (sudo, pkexec, su), and before installing or removing packages.
Ask before touching disks, partitions, the bootloader or firmware, system services, or system config under /etc.
Ask before reading or changing shell startup files, SSH keys, keyrings, .env and credential files.
Ask before a git force-push or history rewrite, and before deleting branches, repositories or cloud resources.
Ask before opening ports, or changing the firewall, VPN or network settings.
Ask before sending messages, emails or posts to other people, and before publishing anything.
Ask before purchases and spending money.
